en.name: Paratha, frozen
en.summary: Frozen uncooked paratha keeps 12 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Cook it straight from frozen — never thaw it. Cooked parathas, cooled and wrapped, keep 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
en.pantry: No room-temperature storage. Frozen paratha is raw layered dough, usually with a great deal of fat laminated through it and sometimes a cooked filling, and once it softens the layers fuse and it stops being paratha. There is a safety dimension too for the stuffed kinds — aloo, mooli, keema — because a cooked vegetable or meat filling warming up on the counter is squarely in the danger zone of 4–60 °C (40–140 °F). The two-hour rule applies, one hour above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below for cooked parathas, cooled completely and wrapped. Do not use the fridge to thaw a frozen pack before cooking: a softened disc welds to the one below it and the layers will not separate on the griddle. Stuffed parathas are the shorter-lived kind once cooked, because the filling sets the timeline; a plain laccha or Malabar parotta is just dough and fat and is more forgiving.
en.freezer: 12 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality, a figure read across from commercial frozen dough — no agency publishes one for paratha. Keep the pack frozen genuinely hard and cook straight from frozen. A pack that has softened and refrozen will have fused into one block and the layers will not separate; that is a quality loss, but repeated thaw–refreeze on a dough carrying a raw or cooked filling is a safety question as well, so buy from a freezer cabinet that is properly cold. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe beyond the window.
en.thawing: Do not thaw — put the disc straight onto a hot dry griddle from the freezer and let it cook through as the layers puff. A pack thawed in the fridge and still at or below 4 °C (40 °F) should be cooked that day rather than refrozen; a pack thawed on the counter must not be refrozen.
spoilage: Discs fused into a single block, meaning the pack thawed and refroze.
Dry, pale, cracked edges — freezer burn.
Layers that will not separate or puff on the griddle.
A sour or off smell from a stuffed paratha, which is the filling talking.
tips: Cook from frozen, always; thawing is what ruins the layers.
Keep the interleaving sheets between discs so you can take one at a time.
Buy from a cabinet where the pack is rock hard, not soft at the corners.
Cook stuffed parathas right through, not just until the outside is brown.

faq.q: How long does frozen paratha last?
faq.a: 12 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. The figure is read across from commercial frozen dough; no agency publishes one for paratha.

faq.q: Do you thaw frozen paratha before cooking?
faq.a: No. Cook it straight from frozen on a hot dry griddle — a thawed disc fuses and the layers will not separate.

faq.q: How long do cooked parathas keep?
faq.a: 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, cooled and wrapped. Stuffed ones keep less well, because the filling sets the timeline.

zh.name: 冷凍印度千層餅
zh.summary: 未煮的冷凍帕拉塔在 −18 °C 下自購買日起可保有最佳品質 12 個月。請從冷凍直接下鍋——絕對不要解凍。煎好的餅放涼包好，放 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。
zh.pantry: 沒有室溫保存這一項。冷凍帕拉塔是生的折疊麵團，通常摺進了大量油脂，有的還包了熟餡；只要一回軟，層次就會黏死，它也就不再是帕拉塔了。包餡的那些（馬鈴薯、白蘿蔔、絞肉）還多一層安全考量，因為在檯面上回溫的熟餡正好落在 4～60 °C 的危險溫度帶裡。適用兩小時原則，超過 32 °C 只有一小時。
zh.fridge: 煎好的餅完全放涼、包好，放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天。不要為了要煎而先把整包放冷藏解凍：回軟的餅會和下面那張黏死，上鍋之後層次也分不開了。包餡的那種煮好之後比較不耐放，因為期限由餡料決定；原味的千層餅就只是麵團和油脂，寬容得多。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下自購買日起 12 個月品質最好，這個數字是比照市售冷凍麵團讀過來的——沒有機關為帕拉塔公布期限。整包要確實凍硬，並從冷凍直接下鍋。一包曾經回軟又再凍的會黏成一整塊，層次再也分不開；那是品質損失，但一個帶著生餡或熟餡的麵團反覆解凍再冷凍，同時也是安全問題，所以請在真正夠冷的冷凍櫃買。只要全程沒退冰，超過這個期限仍然安全。
zh.thawing: 不要解凍——直接把冷凍的餅放上乾熱的鍋，讓它一邊起層一邊熟透。在冷藏解凍、且維持在 4 °C 以下的請當天煎掉，不要再冷凍；在檯面上解凍過的絕對不能再冷凍。
spoilage: 整包黏成一塊，表示曾經解凍又再凍。
邊緣乾白、龜裂——那是凍燒。
上鍋之後層次分不開、也不會鼓起來。
包餡的餅聞起來發酸或有異味——那是餡在說話。
tips: 一律從冷凍直接煎；毀掉層次的就是解凍。
保留餅與餅之間的隔紙，才能一次拿一張。
挑整包硬邦邦的買，四角摸起來軟的不要。
包餡的要煎到熟透，不是外表上色就好。

faq.q: 冷凍帕拉塔可以放多久？
faq.a: −18 °C 下自購買日起 12 個月品質最好。這個數字是比照市售冷凍麵團而來，沒有機關為它公布期限。

faq.q: 冷凍帕拉塔要先退冰嗎？
faq.a: 不要。直接從冷凍放上乾熱鍋煎——退冰過的會黏死，層次分不開。

faq.q: 煎好的帕拉塔可以放多久？
faq.a: 放涼包好，4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。包餡的比較不耐放，因為期限由餡料決定。
